data.name: Spirit Memories
data.description: Once per day, you call upon the unfulfilled desires and goals of your past lives and project their frustration and despair through your eyes at a target. This is a gaze attack affecting one creature. The target must make a Will save (DC %1) or be sickened and staggered for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect. You can use this ability %2 times per day. You must take this revelation at 1st, 3rd, or 7th level.|10+OracleLVL/2+CHA|3+CHA
